correctness.rationale: Forcing plus symmetry of the compatibility relation gives equality of modal successor rows along every compatibility edge and hence throughout each connected component. For an equivalence accessibility relation, reflexivity then forces each compatibility component into a single modal equivalence class. Conversely, every partition of the compatibility components induces an equivalence relation satisfying forcing. The constructions are inverse, so the count is the Bell number of the component count. Exhaustive finite checks corroborate every step.

value.rationale: Equivalence frames satisfying forcing are a designated complete semantic class in the 2026 component-modality work. On finite orthoframes, the theorem reduces their exact search space from arbitrary binary relations on worlds to the partition lattice of compatibility components. The Bell count is independent of component sizes and yields the sharp connected-case collapse to the unique universal relation, making it a natural structural invariant of the source semantics.
